law_cards.observable: A lost prepare response reuses the original canonical request and idempotency key.
law_cards.negative: A changed original source refuses replay; it is never used to regenerate an authored graph.

law_cards.observable: Process restart replays the stored request and original workspace fences without rebasing.
law_cards.negative: A fresh invocation uses fresh fences; retry does not.

law_cards.observable: HTTP expected/pending_draft decoding reaches the same application request as MCP.
law_cards.negative: Cross-route, duplicate, malformed, non-finite, excessive-depth and over-budget query material refuses after authentication and before dispatch.

law_cards.observable: The default fresh 32-hex Y identity is identical in Y's wrapper and G's explicitly replaced gateway-health route artifact before persistence.
law_cards.negative: A copied, current-conflicting, unresolved, foreign-runtime or ambiguous receiver scope refuses instead of minting around owner truth.

law_cards.observable: Absent gateway group preserves exact route bytes; present nonempty replaces the complete group; present empty writes the canonical empty route artifact.
law_cards.negative: Duplicate groups/target IDs, missing selected assignments and partial artifact-slot collisions refuse.

law_cards.observable: A private immutable canonical graph artifact is durably published before its versioned journal and before first dispatch; retry uses those exact bytes.
law_cards.negative: Missing, corrupt, mismatched, unsafe or over-budget artifacts refuse without context/key/identity/route recomputation.

law_cards.observable: X wrapper and retained G transit trust stay byte-identical while only the explicitly selected G route artifact changes across B and C.
law_cards.negative: Fresh G is refused because its target-bearing transit trust is outside the retained-G A-to-B-to-C composition boundary.
